title: Model version stewardship and notice orchestration
creator: Avery Chen
description: Create an operational workflow and cross-functional playbook for stewarding model versions from active support into community notice, migration guidance, and eventual sunset. This ticket codifies: who issues notices and when; what automated tooling (console banners, SDK warnings, API response headers) must be deployed; how to produce migration guides and performance-profile diffs; metrics that gate a sunset (usage, error regressions, cost delta); and a communication cadence for impacted customers and partners. The output will be a reproducible checklist, templates, and a lightweight orchestration automation that triggers notice phases and tracks open migrations.
acceptance_criteria: A single canonical playbook document exists in Confluence (link provided below) covering Notice -> Warning -> Pin -> Sunset phases
Templates created: customer notice email, console banner text, in-API deprecation header, SDK deprecation warning, migration guide template
Console implements a new 'model state' banner that automatically shows the current phase for any model version marked 'deprecated'
Performance-profile diff generator can produce a short summary comparing deprecated version to recommended replacement (latency, cost/token, quality delta) and links to eval prompt set results
Automation to schedule and publish notices (send email, set console banner, create support tasks) exists as a configurable job triggered by PM
Stakeholder sign-offs captured from Legal, Security, Support, and Runtime leads before any public notice
tasks: PM: Draft phase definitions and timelines (Notice 90d, Warning 45d, Pin 30d, Sunset 0d) and publish for review
Eng: Add model-state metadata to model registry and API surface (tags: active, maintain, deprecated, sunset-ready)
Eng: Implement in-API deprecation header and SDK warnings (node/python) with link to migration guide
Console: Create banner UI slot and admin toggle for deprecation phase visibility
DX: Write migration guide template and two example migrations (quantized->float-compatible; hf-weights->redwood-optimized variant)
Support: Create support playbook and canned responses for customers reporting failures after notice
Legal: Review and approve customer notice language and data-retention implications
PM: Run a pilot with 3 non-production model versions to validate automation and messaging
communications_plan: Phased communication: 90-day public notice (blog + console banner + email to registered API keys), 45-day warning with migration content and suggested replacement, 30-day pin period where customers can opt to pin a version for an extended grace period (admin action + paid pin), final sunset notice 7 days prior and automatic routing to fallback model variant after sunset. Internal channels: #product-lifecycle for running commentary, weekly sync with runtime and support during active campaigns. Use templated messages and track opens/clicks via marketing analytics. Escalation path: any high-usage customer flagged during notice -> account success rep engages within 48 hours.
rollout_timeline: Phase 0 (2 weeks): finalize definitions and automation spec. Phase 1 (4 weeks): model registry tags + console UI + SDK warnings. Phase 2 (2 weeks): migration guide templates and performance-diff tool. Phase 3 (2 weeks): pilot with non-prod versions. Phase 4: first live run and retrospective.
migration_tooling_requirements: Performance diff generator that outputs latency/cost/quality summaries and markdown snippets
One-click 'Create migration PR' in repo templates populated with recommended model pins and example prompts
SDK deprecation hooks that surface a single link to a migration guide and example replacement code
Admin panel to grant paid 'pin' for customers that require extended support
Automation to create a Linear ticket for each impacted high-usage customer with prefilled context
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: High-usage customers break in production when a variant is removed. Mitigation: allow paid pinning + automated fallback to compatible variant + account-level notifications before sunset
Risk: Confusion from inconsistent messaging across console, SDK, and emails. Mitigation: single-source-of-truth templates and automation that populates all channels from the model registry state
Risk: Legal/regulatory blockers for data retention on private deployments. Mitigation: require Legal sign-off and include on-prem exceptions in the playbook
Risk: Unexpected quality regressions in recommended replacements. Mitigation: require perf/QA signoff with eval prompt sets and release gating before public notice
